description.intro: The Nike FC Barcelona 26/27 Dri-FIT Stadium children's goalkeeper shirt is designed for young goalkeepers to defend the Blaugrana goal in total comfort. key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT: Helps wick away sweat to keep skin dry and comfortable.
Long sleeve: Greater coverage and protection during game actions.
Official goalkeeper design: Inspired by the kit used by FC Barcelona goalkeepers.
Light and breathable fabric: Promotes freedom of movement and comfort.
